artworks.title: Landscape with a Bridge
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
overall (approximate): 20.5 x 26.9 cm (8 1/16 x 10 9/16 in.)
support: 26.6 x 40.5 cm (10 1/2 x 15 15/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Ronald S. Lauder
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a bridge, trees, mountains on the horizon, and a seated figure. The bridge is made of stone pillars and wooden planks. The color palette is sepia-toned with a warm and timeless atmosphere. Brushstrokes are soft and sketch-like, giving a sense of movement and texture.

artworks.title: Roche Taillet sur la Saosne proche Lyon
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a historical scene showing a fortified castle or large structure to the left. The structure is on a hill, with walls, towers, and the sky in the background. There are boats on the waters at the bottom of the image, and rolling hills extend into the distance. The sky has swirling clouds drawn in fine lines reminiscent of traditional etching. The color palette is monochromatic, highlighting the detailed line work and creating a subdued, historical ambiance.

artworks.title: Veue du Chasteau d'Ansy le franc du coste du jeu de longue paume
artworks.description: The image shows a grand chateau to the right, set against a clear sky with fine lines that could represent clouds or be blank space. The chateau features classical architecture, multiple chimneys, and intricate rooflines. Detailed etching lines create texture, especially in the foliage of large trees on the left. The color scheme is black ink on light paper. There are figures in the foreground and near the chateau, with more trees and architectural elements visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Veue de la Tour de Quinquangrongne
artworks.description: The image depicts a castle in a landscape, seen from an elevated angle. The castle is the main focus, displaying textured walls in earthy tones. Figures are walking towards the entrance, with a distant cityscape and water visible beyond. Clouds and tree branches frame the background.

artworks.title: Le coin des Bons hommes proche de Paris
artworks.description: The image shows a scene near a riverbank with a high horizon line. A large building complex and trees are visible on the horizon. The fine and precise brushstrokes give detail to the architectural elements and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic with black ink and cream paper. Figures walk along a path leading to a stone wall and a small building, while boats sail on the water in the distance. Additional buildings line the opposite shoreline, and there are expansive clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Veue de la Tour de Grignon
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a stone castle on a hill, a horizon line below the center, a sky filled with swirling clouds, detailed etching techniques creating texture and depth, people walking along a path, and a monochromatic color palette of sepia and black.

artworks.title: L'hostel d'Angoulesme
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed architectural drawing of a grand building viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The large structure features numerous windows and elaborately decorated facades. Additional structures can be seen in the distance, offering a sense of depth. The horizon is high, just above the rooftops of the buildings, and stylized clouds are sketched in delicate lines. The drawing technique is meticulous with fine lines and hatching providing shading. The color palette is sepia tones, giving a classical appearance. Close to us are gardens with pathways, trees, and figures engaged in various activities, adding life to the scene. The overall impression is one of elegance and architectural grandeur.

artworks.title: Veue de Pont et partie de la Ville de Grenoble
artworks.description: This image shows an engraved view of a bridge in a cityscape, possibly Grenoble. The view is from an elevated position looking towards the city. The horizon line is low, with mountains in the distance. The engraving showcases detailed line work for the architecture and natural elements. A rocky riverbank is in the foreground with a small figure. A tall tower rises in the city's core, with buildings extending toward the mountains. The color palette is monochromatic, predominantly brown and tan.

artworks.title: Le Grotte de Meudon
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a horizon at the upper part. Various elements such as trees, houses, and a building resembling a small palace are depicted in detailed, precise lines, typical of engraving techniques. The color scheme is monochromatic, using sepia tones for contrast. People are visible near the building, with more vegetation and structures in the background.

artworks.title: Veue de Larcenal
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing buildings along a river. The horizon line is visible with rooftops and chimneys. The etching has detailed and defined brushstrokes creating texture in trees and clouds. The color palette consists of sepia or brown ink on pale paper. Close to the viewer are boats on the river with figures. In the distance, there are trees, vegetation, and open fields. The sky has soft clouds.

artworks.title: Veue des bons hommes
artworks.description: The image shows a riverbank with a grand building complex across the river. The buildings, especially the one with a church and steeple, stand out with detailed architectural features. Additional structures can be seen in the distance. The artwork features fine line work and cross-hatching to depict textures. The color scheme is monochrome, similar to an engraving. The foreground includes a detailed riverbank with two small figures, while the sky is illustrated with delicate cloud linework to create a light and airy background.

artworks.title: Veue et Perspectiue du Palais et Jardins des Thuilleries
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of the Palais and Gardens of the Tuileries and the skyline of Paris. Precise line work and hatching are used to depict the scene. Boats with arched coverings sail in the water, leading towards rows of trees and palace structures. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily using beige and black hues.

artworks.title: Palais de la Reyne Catherine de Medicis
artworks.description: The image shows a grand palace in the center of the composition, with its detailed architecture rendered in fine lines. The palace has chimneys emitting smoke on both sides. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones. In front of the palace are symmetrically arranged garden beds with paths and people walking along them. The palace stands majestically in the distance.

artworks.title: Plan general du Chasteau et petit Parc de Vincennes
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a castle complex in the distance, two figures on the left, and trees framing the sides. The sky has scattered clouds, and the color palette consists of sepia and deep brown tones. Architectural elements including turrets, a central tower, and a spire are visible on the horizon line.

artworks.title: Veue de l'Abbaye Sainct Michel de Tonnerre
artworks.description: The image shows a large, elaborate abbey with intricate architectural details. The perspective is slightly elevated, providing a clear view of the facade with detailed windows and spires. The horizon is above the center of the image, showing rolling hills, fields, and a sky with thin clouds. The scene is monochromatic, likely from an etching technique, with fine lines creating texture. Tiny figures on the path add scale and activity to the serene scene.

artworks.title: Veue de Berny a deux lieues de Paris sur le chemin d'Orléans
artworks.description: The image shows a grand estate viewed straight-on. The building has a symmetrical design with trees rising above it. The illustration utilizes fine lines typical of engraving or etching techniques. The color scheme is monochromatic with brownish tones. In the foreground, a body of water is shown with people fishing and rowing a boat. In the central courtyard, small human figures are depicted. In the background, details of the mansion such as chimneys and dormer windows add character to the composition.

artworks.title: La Maijorre de Marseille
artworks.description: The image is an etching presenting a coastal scene. The composition is circular, showing a view of an ancient stone structure on a rocky shoreline. There are boats with tall masts, figures near the water, and fine line work depicting water texture. The horizon meets the sea and sky, with distant structures and a tall tower. The sky contains wispy clouds made with delicate, horizontal strokes. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of sepia and brown, enhancing the historic atmosphere of the setting.

artworks.title: Veue de la Maison de Monsieur de Bretonuillerdans l'Isle Nostre Dame
artworks.description: The image features an etching showing urban architecture from an elevated perspective. A large building is diagonally placed on the left side of the image. Intricately dressed figures walk along the street, and a horse-drawn carriage is visible. In the background, a river stretches into the distance with boats and buildings along its banks. The etching is detailed with fine lines and shading to indicate depth and texture, rendered in a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: Veue de l'Hostel de Soissons
artworks.description: This is an etching of an estate, viewed from a garden. The horizon is not prominently marked, obscured by the house and trees. There are birds in the sky. The fine lines in the etching show detailed architecture, with high roofs and an ornate facade. The color palette is monochrome, using variations of brown ink. There is a pond reflecting the estate, with people walking, one sitting with a dog. In the distance, foliage and the estate blend in a garden landscape.

artworks.title: Veue du Pont de pierre de Rouen
artworks.description: The viewpoint is from across the river, showing the scene of a stone bridge in Rouen. The horizon is low, with the architectural silhouettes and masts of ships extending upwards. The horizon guides the viewer to the bridge spanning the river, towering over boats and people. The etching technique features precise linework capturing details like the bridge's texture and water movement. The monochromatic image uses varying line densities and shading for depth. Closest are small boats with figures, some conversing. Further back, ships with tall masts are docked along the river. The stone bridge in the distance adds an architectural element, with city buildings in the backdrop.

artworks.title: Veue de l'Eglise nostre Dame de Rouen
artworks.description: The image shows boats with people in a river. In the background, there is the Cathedral of Notre-Dame in Rouen, a bridge, and other architectural structures. The scene is depicted in black ink on cream-colored paper, with detailed etching capturing the buildings and the activities on the water.

artworks.title: L'Hostel de Vandosme a Paris
artworks.description: The image displays a frontal view of an elaborate architectural structure labeled as "LHOSTEL DE VANDOMSE A PARIS." The perspective is direct and symmetrical, with the building in the center of the composition. Columns and intricate architectural details are precisely illustrated. The color palette is sepia, giving the scene a historical appearance. Several figures are depicted close to us, walking or standing in small groups. In the distance, the landscape includes tall trees and hills.

artworks.title: Veue de Prieure et Village de Croissy
artworks.description: The image shows a village scene from an elevated viewpoint, featuring a landscape with buildings, hills, and distant scenery. The artwork is detailed with fine line work using sepia and beige tones. People are engaged in activities near the foreground, while further back, structures like a church and village buildings are visible under a partially cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Veue du Luxembourg
artworks.description: The image is an etching of the Luxembourg Palace as seen from the garden side from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is near the upper third of the image, showing the palace structure meeting the sky. The palace, with its classic architectural details, is intricately detailed through precise, linear engravings. To the left, a row of trees runs parallel to a stone wall, depicted with delicate cross-hatching representing foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, with rich brown ink on cream-colored paper. People in period clothing are shown closer to us, while figures in the distance appear to be walking leisurely.
